key.name: lockscreen-enabled
key.description: When enabled, Live LockPaper renders video on the lock screen. Disable to keep the default static lock screen while still allowing desktop video wallpaper.

key.name: background-video-paths
key.summary: Paths to background videos (for random selection)

key.name: background-video-auto-fps
key.summary: Automatically detect and use video FPS

key.name: background-video-metadata
key.summary: Video metadata (FPS, resolution, duration) stored as path -> {fps: int, width: int, height: int, duration: i, playCount: i}

key.name: background-video-transition-type
key.summary: Video transition type (0=none, 1=fade, 2=crossfade, 3=slide left, 4=slide right, 5=slide up, 6=slide down, 7=zoom in, 8=zoom out)

key.name: background-video-start-position
key.summary: Video start position in seconds (0 = start from beginning, -1 = resume from last position)

key.name: background-video-last-positions
key.summary: Last playback positions for videos (path -> position in seconds)

key.name: prompt-pause-video
key.summary: Whether to pause the video on password prompt

key.name: prompt-change-blur
key.summary: Whether to change the blur value on password prompt

key.name: prompt-blur-radius
key.summary: Background video blur radius on password prompt

key.name: prompt-blur-brightness
key.summary: Background video brightness on password prompt

key.name: prompt-blur-anim-duration
key.summary: Background video blur change animation duration

key.name: prompt-grayscale
key.description: Apply a desaturation (grayscale) effect to the lock screen video when the password prompt appears. Provides a subtle visual cue that the prompt is active.

key.name: general-disable-on-battery
key.description: Automatically disable video wallpaper when the device is running on battery power. Helps conserve battery life on laptops.

key.name: background-video-per-monitor
key.summary: Use different videos per monitor on lock screen
key.description: When enabled, each monitor can have its own set of videos on the lock screen

key.name: background-video-per-monitor-config
key.description: JSON object mapping monitor connector names to arrays of video paths. Example: {"DP-1": ["/path/a.mp4"], "HDMI-1": ["/path/b.mp4"]}

key.name: debug-skip-frame
key.summary: Whether to skip the first frame of video or not
key.description: Sometimes the very first frame of the video might be completely green, so there is an option to skip it

key.name: debug-prefer-hardware-decoder
key.description: When enabled, prioritises VA-API and NVDEC hardware decoders over software decoders. Reduces CPU usage significantly but may not work on all systems.

key.name: debug-gpu-color-conversion
key.description: Use OpenGL for YUV→BGRA colour conversion instead of CPU. Can significantly reduce CPU usage on systems with good GPU drivers. Requires GStreamer GL plugins.

key.name: debug-pause-when-hidden
key.summary: Pause wallpaper when desktop is hidden
key.description: Automatically pause wallpaper video playback when all monitors are fully covered by maximised or fullscreen windows. Saves CPU/GPU when the wallpaper is not visible.

key.name: pause-when-hidden-mode
key.description: 0 = Off (never pause), 1 = Pause when all monitors are fullscreen, 2 = Pause when any monitor is fullscreen

key.name: debug-push-frame-delivery
key.description: Replaces the fixed-interval polling timer with an adaptive scheduler. When a frame is available it re-polls immediately; when the decoder has no frame ready it backs off to the normal interval. Reduces empty polls and can lower CPU usage.

key.name: debug-use-gtk4-sink
key.description: When false (default), use the external GTK4 subprocess with gtk4paintablesink for better performance. When true, force the old in-process appsink renderer for compatibility testing. Falls back to appsink automatically if gtk4paintablesink is not available.

key.name: debug-gtk-helper-logs
key.description: When enabled, logs detailed information including GTK helper window state, sleep/wake events, and other debug information. Keep disabled for normal use to reduce journal noise.

key.name: debug-show-panel-button
key.description: Shows the Live LockPaper quick-controls button in the top bar with play/pause, next video, and quick toggles. Disable to hide the panel button.

key.name: panel-icon-mode
key.description: 0 = Dynamic (standard GNOME icons), 1 = Dynamic (custom icons), 2 = Static (original icon), 3 = Static (custom icon)

key.name: panel-icon-custom-static
key.description: Filename of custom static icon (e.g., "flower.png"). Place in extension/icons/ directory.

key.name: panel-icon-custom-dynamic-wallpaper
key.summary: Custom dynamic icon for wallpaper enabled
key.description: Filename of icon to show when wallpaper is enabled (e.g., "wallpaper.png"). Place in extension/icons/ directory.

key.name: panel-icon-custom-dynamic-lockscreen
key.summary: Custom dynamic icon for lockscreen enabled
key.description: Filename of icon to show when lockscreen is enabled (e.g., "lockscreen.png"). Place in extension/icons/ directory.

key.name: panel-icon-custom-dynamic-both
key.summary: Custom dynamic icon for both enabled
key.description: Filename of icon to show when both wallpaper and lockscreen are enabled (e.g., "both.png"). Place in extension/icons/ directory.

key.name: panel-icon-custom-dynamic-none
key.summary: Custom dynamic icon for both disabled
key.description: Filename of icon to show when both wallpaper and lockscreen are disabled (e.g., "none.png"). Place in extension/icons/ directory.

key.name: wallpaper-enabled
key.summary: Enable video wallpaper on the desktop

key.name: wallpaper-random-order
key.summary: Play wallpaper videos in random order

key.name: wallpaper-per-monitor
key.description: When enabled, each monitor can have its own set of videos configured independently

key.name: wallpaper-per-monitor-config
key.description: JSON object mapping monitor connector names to arrays of video paths. Example: {"DP-1": ["/path/a.mp4"], "HDMI-1": ["/path/b.mp4"]}

key.name: wallpaper-quality
key.summary: Wallpaper render quality (percentage of monitor resolution)
key.description: Lower values reduce GPU/CPU load but may look blurrier. 100 = native resolution, 75 = good balance, 50 = performance mode.

key.name: wallpaper-disable-on-battery
key.description: Automatically disable video wallpaper when the device is running on battery power. Helps conserve battery life on laptops.

key.name: lockscreen-disable-on-battery
key.summary: Disable lock screen video on battery power
key.description: Automatically disable lock screen video when the device is running on battery power. Helps conserve battery life on laptops.

key.name: lockscreen-text-customize-enabled
key.description: Apply custom styles and formats to lock screen time, date, and hint labels.

key.name: lockscreen-text-hide-cmd
key.summary: Hide lock screen command output text

key.name: lockscreen-text-hide-hint
key.description: Hide the lock screen hint label when custom text styling is enabled.

key.name: lockscreen-text-cmd-size
key.summary: Lock screen command output font size

key.name: lockscreen-text-cmd-color
key.summary: Lock screen command output text color

key.name: lockscreen-text-cmd-font
key.summary: Lock screen command output font family

key.name: lockscreen-text-time-font
key.description: Optional font-family value for lock screen time text. Empty uses default GNOME font.

key.name: lockscreen-text-date-font
key.description: Optional font-family value for lock screen date text. Empty uses default GNOME font.

key.name: lockscreen-text-hint-font
key.description: Optional font-family value for lock screen hint text. Empty uses default GNOME font.

key.name: lockscreen-text-cmd-weight
key.summary: Lock screen command output font weight

key.name: lockscreen-text-cmd-style
key.summary: Lock screen command output font style

key.name: lockscreen-text-time-format
key.description: strftime format for time text. Leave empty to use GNOME default.

key.name: lockscreen-text-date-format
key.description: strftime format for date text. Leave empty to use GNOME default.

key.name: lockscreen-text-cmd-command
key.summary: Shell command for extra lock screen text line
key.description: Optional shell command. Stdout is shown as a separate line above time/date/hint labels.

key.name: lockscreen-keep-awake-enabled
key.summary: Keep lock screen visible after locking
key.description: Prevents immediate lock screen blanking so lock screen wallpaper stays visible.

key.name: lockscreen-keep-awake-timeout-seconds
key.summary: Seconds until lock screen can blank
key.description: 0 means never force blank from this feature.

key.name: lockscreen-keep-awake-only-on-ac
key.summary: Only keep lock screen visible on AC power
key.description: When enabled, keep-awake behavior is disabled while running on battery.
